title: Module base change along a canonical ring tensor equivalence
statement: Let $A,B,R,S$ be commutative rings, with an $R$-algebra structure on $S$, ring maps $f:A\to B$, $g:A\to R$, $k:B\to S$, a $B$-module $N$, an $S$-module $M$, and an additive map $q:N\to M$. Suppose there is a ring isomorphism $e_r:B\otimes_A R\to S$ satisfying $e_r(b\otimes r)=k(b)\varphi(r)$, where $\varphi:R\to S$ is the algebra map, and an $S$-linear isomorphism $e_m:S\otimes_B N\to M$ satisfying $e_m(s\otimes x)=s q(x)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Then, viewing $N$ as an $A$-module via $f$ and $M$ as an $R$-module via $\varphi$, there is an $R$-linear isomorphism $R\otimes_A N\to M$ sending $r\otimes x$ to $\varphi(r)q(x)$.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00R1 (lemma-limit-module-finite-presentation), final displayed isomorphism over R_lambda, expanded using tensor cancellation

proof.text: The formula for the ring equivalence makes it B-linear: e_r((b tensor 1)t)=k(b)e_r(t), by multiplicativity and the formula at b tensor 1. Thus it induces a B-linear tensor equivalence when tensored with N.

Invert tensor cancellation, tensor the B-linear ring equivalence with N, swap the two B-tensor factors, and apply e_m restricted to B-scalars. Swap the initial A-tensor factors to obtain an additive equivalence R tensor_A N → M. On r tensor x it has value φ(r)q(x), using the inverse cancellation formula and the two assumed formulas.

The additive equivalence is R-linear: on a pure tensor, its value after multiplication by r equals φ(r) times its value, by multiplicativity of φ and the module associativity law. Tensor induction extends the identity to arbitrary tensors. Package this equivalence and its pure-tensor formula.

theorem moduleBaseChangeAcrossPushout
    (A B R S : Type u) (N M : Type v)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N] [AddCommGroup M] [Module S M]
    (f : A →+* B) (g : A →+* R) (k : B →+* S) (q : N →+ M)
    (hring : letI := f.toAlgebra; letI := g.toAlgebra
      ∃ e : B ⊗[A] R ≃+* S,
        ∀ (x : B) (y : R), e (x ⊗ₜ[A] y) = k x * algebraMap R S y)
    (hmodule : letI := k.toAlgebra
      ∃ e : S ⊗[B] N ≃ₗ[S] M,
        ∀ (y : S) (x : N), e (y ⊗ₜ[B] x) = y • q x) :
    letI := g.toAlgebra
    letI : Module A N := Module.compHom N f
    letI : Module R M := Module.compHom M (algebraMap R S)
    ∃ e : R ⊗[A] N ≃ₗ[R] M,
      ∀ (y : R) (x : N), e (y ⊗ₜ[A] x) = algebraMap R S y • q x
